note: What MFL's trade records leave out, added back by scripts/awards.py (apply_trade_fixes) for the Awards page and the Trading Floor. MFL couldn't carry rookie picks until the 2021 draft was set up, so 2020 trades that included a 2021 pick show nothing on that side; the commissioner later moved those picks with one-way entries (March and June 2021), which are bookkeeping, not trades. Picks are tied back to their trade from the 2021 draft results ('Pick traded from ...') and the one-way entries; cash is auction cash MFL doesn't record (amt null when the amount isn't known).

picks.why: Fully Cooked's 2021 1st to MR. FROBOT for James Conner (Nov 10, 2020); the pick became 1.05, Ja'Marr Chase. Commissioner confirmed; MFL moved the pick Mar 19, 2021.
Bullish's 2021 2nd to MR. FROBOT for Cam Akers (Oct 27, 2020); became 2.11, Pat Freiermuth. MFL moved the pick Mar 19, 2021.
Bullish's 2021 1st to Son of Tinactin for Chris Carson (Dec 2, 2020); MFL moved the pick Mar 19, 2021. SOT sent it on to JCC in the May 25, 2021 swap, where it became 1.11, Elijah Moore.
Bullish's 2022 2nd to Hauk Tua with the Josh Jacobs trade (Oct 21, 2021): the commissioner moved the pick 23 minutes after the trade.

cash.why: Bullish sent auction cash to Hauk Tua for Josh Jacobs (Sep 5, 2020); the amount wasn't recorded. Commissioner confirmed.

drop.why: The commissioner re-entering the 1.02/1.04 half of the May 25, 2021 JCC-SOT pick swap the day before the draft; the trade itself is May 25.
